sources.title: Sailor2-1B-Chat in GGUF: A Tiny, Offline Multilingual Chat Model for ...
sources.snippet: DevQuasar/sail.Sailor2-1B-Chat-GGUF on Modelers.cn is a quantised, llama.cpp-compatible repackaging of Sailor2-1B-Chat, the smallest member of Sea AI Lab's Sailor2 multilingual family. At roughly 1B parameters, it is designed to run cheaply, offline and on modest hardware, from CPU-only boxes to edge devices.

sources.title: Sailor2-1B Goes GGUF on Modelers.cn: Tiny, Local, and Worth a Look
sources.snippet: If you're hunting for a small multilingual model that can run locally without a GPU, Modelers.cn has a new GGUF build worth adding to your test bench. DevQuasar/sail.Sailor2-1B-GGUF is a quantised version of the Sailor2-1B text-generation model, packaged for llama.cpp-style runtimes. At roughly 1B parameters, it's aimed squarely at edge deployment, quick prototypes, and low-resource inference ...

sources.title: GitHub - sail-sg/sailor2: Sailor2: Sailing in South-East Asia with ...
sources.snippet: This repository contains the code for Sailor2, a powerful and inclusive open language models for South-East Asia. Sailor2 is a collaborative project partnered with Sea AI Lab, SCB10X, WiseSight, HuggingFace and the Sailor2 Community.
